column1: # Retrieved 2026-10-20: `git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/python/cpython` listed 677 tags; 657 are rows and 20 are excluded below.
# source_ref is the upstream tag URL; source_sha is the commit the tag names (peeled for annotated tags).
# date: the release's `Release date` line in Misc/NEWS

#   date nearest the tag date. Otherwise the tag date (annotated) or tagged/cvs2svn commit date
#   with a `?` suffix (60 rows). See README.md.
# predecessor/lineage: previous release on the same X.Y line
#   (most recent earlier release of a lower line whose tagged commit is a git ancestor).
